description:
You are a project manager conducting a pre-release compliance audit of the ReqView project. The audit has revealed status inconsistencies between the SRS document and the ARCH (Architecture) document.

The architecture document (ARCH) contains components that have 'Implementation' traceability links to SRS requirements they implement. For a release to proceed, all SRS requirements that are implemented by architecture components must have their status set to 'Released'.

During a recent bulk status reset, the following SRS requirements — which ARE implemented by architecture components — had their status incorrectly changed away from 'Released':

1. SRS-56 (Open File) — currently shows 'Draft' instead of 'Released'
2. SRS-83 (Requirements Table) — currently shows 'Reviewed' instead of 'Released'
3. SRS-106 (Create Requirement) — currently shows 'Draft' instead of 'Released'
4. SRS-137 (Traceability Links) — currently shows 'Ready' instead of 'Released'
5. SRS-163 (Print) — currently shows 'Reviewed' instead of 'Released'

For each of these requirements:
a) Navigate to the requirement in the SRS document
b) Verify it has an incoming implementation link from ARCH (visible in the Links column)
c) Change its status to 'Released'

You may verify the architecture links by switching to the ARCH document and checking the implementation traceability, or by examining the Links column in the SRS document.

Login credentials: The application is already open with the project loaded.
